If the goal is to "Update docs for responses and new stream with `yield`", and `docs/en/docs/advanced/stream-data.md` already has it, maybe it should be added to `docs/en/docs/advanced/custom-response.md` as well, because that's where other responses are documented.

In `docs/en/docs/advanced/custom-response.md`, the `StreamingResponse` section is very brief:

```markdown
### `StreamingResponse` { #streamingresponse }

Takes an async generator or a normal generator/iterator and streams the response body.

{* ../../docs_src/custom_response/tutorial007_py310.py hl[3,16] *}

/// note | Technical Details

An `async` task can only be cancelled when it reaches an `await`. If there is no `await`, the generator (function with `yield`) can not be cancelled properly and may keep running even after cancellation is requested.
```
